cd /workspace && LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/vendor:/workspace/submission timeout 280 python3 -c "
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import planner
from gen2 import gen_case
rng = random.Random(0)
case = gen_case(rng, 512, 256, 32, 16)
rounds=[];imps=[]
orig_a=planner._block_a
def a(net,cap):
    rounds[-1]+=1
    return orig_a(net,cap)
planner._block_a=a
orig_d=planner._dijkstra
def d(net,cap):
    rounds.append(0); imps.append([])
    return orig_d(net,cap)
planner._dijkstra=d
orig_b=planner._block_b
def b(net,cap):
    before=list(net.wdist)
    r=orig_b(net,cap)
    imps[-1].append(sum(1 for x,y in zip(before,net.wdist) if y<x))
    return r
planner._block_b=b
res=planner.solve_epoch(case)
print('dijkstra calls',len(rounds))
import collections
print('round distribution', collections.Counter(rounds).most_common(10))
tot=sum(rounds); print('total rounds',tot)
# improvement patterns
pat = collections.Counter(tuple(x) for x in imps)
print('top patterns', pat.most_common(6))
" 2>&1 | tail -8
